stemMd: A position-time graph is a straight line sloping downwards as time increases. What does it describe?
explanationMd: Velocity is the slope of a position-time graph. A straight downward line has a constant negative slope, hence constant negative velocity and zero acceleration.

distractorRationale.c: Rest would give a horizontal line.
distractorRationale.e: A straight position-time line has constant slope.
distractorRationale.b: Time still increases along the horizontal axis.
